verdict.rationale: Ramp documents an API reference as a plain-text export (/llms-api.txt), a canonical OpenAPI schema with 174 paths, a docs MCP server and a sandbox. None of the evidence shows an interactive reference with runnable or 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI spec and sandbox are building blocks a developer could use to test calls, not the interactive reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
